exposure: spontaneous or artificial rupture of membranes
attempt of vaginal birth after a cesarian section
outcome: Association between risk factors and uterine rupture/dehiscence
cohort: Patients with uterine rupture/dehiscence from a tertiary teaching hospital in Canada, from January 1998 to December 2017
finding: While uterine rupture was associated with severe maternal and fetal outcomes, uterine dehiscence was also associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, highlighting the need to consider both as potentially serious complications.
mod_finding: This study found that attempted vaginal birth after cesarean section was associated with uterine dehiscence, but not uterine rupture.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries were more common in the uterine rupture group (36.5 ± 4.9 weeks) compared to the dehiscence group (38.2 ± 2.9 weeks)
